## Integration checklist

- [ ] Reviewed root README and runner; updated them where behavior/status changed.
- [ ] New analysis is registered in run_all.py, or explicitly documented as unfinished.
- [ ] Sources, units, dates, cleaning decisions and shared schemas are documented.
- [ ] Raw inputs are unchanged; no credentials or personal paths are added.
- [ ] Dependencies and affected generated outputs are updated where applicable.

- [ ] Read data/README.md and source_manifest.json before push; reused existing shared inputs without copies.
- [ ] Registered any new shared source/derived data and documented part-specific intermediate tables.

## Verification
